column1: 20508§ubiquitous§juːˈbɪkwɪtəs§Internet bars were ubiquitous those days.§那段时间网吧很**普遍**。§
20509§formulate§ˈfɔːmjuleɪt§She cannot formulate her idea in a few words.§她无法用几句话**阐明**自己的思想。§
20510§collate§kəˈleɪt§Customers' comments are collated regularly to identify opportunities for improvement.§顾客的意见会被定期**核对**，以确保公司能在适当的时机进行改进。§
20511§infer§ɪnˈfɜː(r)§I infer from your letter that you have not made up your mind yet.§我从你的信中**推断**出你还没下定决心。§
20512§fiction§ˈfɪkʃn§Suddenly, the stuff of science fiction doesn't seem so fanciful anymore.§这些科幻**小说**似乎突然就不再那么让人充满幻想了。§
20513§ability§əˈbɪləti§Classes are organised according to ability level.§根据**能力**水平进行分班。§
20514§sector§ˈsektə(r)§Nowadays more women are being employed in the business sector.§现在，就职于商业**部门**的女性越来越多。§
20515§creep§kriːp§I crept upstairs so as not to wake up other tenants.§我**悄悄地爬**上楼，以免吵醒其他房客。§
20516§casual§ˈkæʒuəl§Helen occasionally wears casual clothes during classes.§海伦有时候在课上穿**便**装。§
20517§interpretation§ɪnˌtɜːprɪˈteɪʃn§My interpretation of the drama was rather superficial.§我对戏剧的**理解**相当肤浅。§
20518§trimester§traɪˈmestə(r)§The academic year is divided into three trimesters.§一学年分为三**学期**。§
20519§consensus§kənˈsensəs§The general consensus is that the reform is a good thing.§改革是件好事，这是**共识**。§
20520§redevelopment§ˌriːdɪˈveləpmənt§Now, the theatre is reopening soon after its three-year redevelopment.§经过三年的**重建**，现在这家剧场很快就要重新开放了。§
20521§auditorium§ˌɔːdɪˈtɔːriəm§Will the audience find any difference in the auditorium?§观众们会发现这个**礼堂**有什么不同吗？§改例句：audience 前缺冠词，补 the
20522§condition§kənˈdɪʃn§The research ignored the social and environmental conditions affecting health.§这一研究忽略了影响人类健康的社会环境和自然**环境**。§
20523§narrator§nəˈreɪtə(r)§Peter worked as a narrator in the company.§彼得在该公司做**解说员**。§
20524§furnish§ˈfɜːnɪʃ§You can get free advice on furnishing your home from the interior designer.§你可以从室内设计师那儿免费获得关于家居**装潢**的建议。§
20525§stabilise§ˈsteɪbəlaɪz§The patient's condition has now stabilised.§现在病人的情况已经**稳定**下来了。§
20526§incoming§ˈɪnkʌmɪŋ§Telephones in this hall can only be used to call out; they will not receive incoming calls.§大厅里的电话只能打出，而不能接听外面**打进来的**电话。§

20527§alignment§əˈlaɪnmənt§If your bed doesn't give enough support, back muscles and ligaments will work all night trying to correct spinal alignment, so you wake up with a tired aching back.§如果你的床不能给你足够的支撑，背部肌肉和韧带便会整晚工作以**校直**脊椎，因此在第二天醒来时你就会觉得腰酸背痛。§
20528§boot§buːt§You'd better take along a good pair of hiking boots if you want to take advantage of the wonderful trails in the mountains.§如果想要领略在山中徒步旅行的惊险刺激，你最好带上一双好点儿的户外**长靴**。§
20529§acid§ˈæsɪd§DNA is the short form of deoxyribonucleic acid.§DNA是脱氧核糖核**酸**的缩写形式。§
20530§booming§ˈbuːmɪŋ§The booming tourism industry has created thousands of new jobs in the coastal region over the past decade.§过去十年间，**迅速发展的**旅游业在沿海地区创造了数千个新的就业岗位。§补例句
20531§definite§ˈdefɪnət§I have no definite plans for my future.§我对未来并没有**明确的**规划。§
20532§deem§diːm§The WHO deems that a city with more than ten million inhabitants has exceeded the healthy level.§世界卫生组织**认为**，人口在一千万以上的城市已经超过了健康标准的要求。§
20533§reorient§riˈɔːrient§Our students are reoriented towards social development.§我们的学生要被培养成**适应**社会发展的类型。§
20534§reckon§ˈrekən§Did you reckon in the cost of these raw materials?§你把买这些原材料的费用**算进去**了吗？§改例句：句末中文问号改为英文问号
20535§tutorial§tjuːˈtɔːriəl§I think you should be ready for today's tutorial on "how to find a good job".§我认为你已经为今天的**辅导课**“如何找到好工作”做好了准备。§改例句：英文句中的中文引号改为英文引号
20536§reference§ˈrefrəns§The teachers will not give the range of reference books.§老师们不会给出**参考**书的范围。§
20537§sledge§sledʒ§Supplies were brought to us on large sledges from a ship fifteen kilometers away.§供给品是从15公里外的船上用大**雪橇**拉来的。§
20538§exaggerate§ɪgˈzædʒəreɪt§The witness exaggerated the seriousness of the accident.§目击者**夸大**了事故的严重性。§
20539§restriction§rɪˈstrɪkʃn§There's an open ticket which doesn't have any restrictions on time.§有一种不定期客票，对时间没有任何**限制**。§
20540§abandon§əˈbændən§She and her tribe had to abandon their lands and retreat to Canada.§她和她的部落被迫**放弃**了土地，退到加拿大。§
20541§terrify§ˈterɪfaɪ§Uniforms for the military were originally intended to impress and even terrify the enemy.§穿着军装的最初目的是为了给敌人留下深刻印象甚至是将他们**吓退**。§
20542§priority§praɪˈɒrəti§The film stars went onto the stage according to priority of their appearance in the film.§影星们按照他们在影片中出现的**先后顺序**依次上台。§
20543§habitat§ˈhæbɪtæt§They have focused their research on habitats they believe have escaped human influence.§他们已将研究重心放在他们认为不受人类影响的物种**栖息地**上。§

20544§encourage§ɪnˈkʌrɪdʒ§To encourage the bees to produce as much honey as possible, the beekeepers open the hives and stack extra boxes on top.§为了**促使**蜜蜂尽可能多地产蜜，养蜂人打开蜂箱，在上面加放了一些盒子。§改译文：「让」没有 encourage 的意思，改为「促使」
20545§celebrity§səˈlebrəti§The lecture will be given by a sports celebrity.§这场讲座将由一位体育**名人**主讲。§
20546§significance§sɪgˈnɪfɪkəns§The real significance of the first Kodak camera was that it was backed up by a developing and printing service.§第一代柯达相机的真正**意义**在于它可以连接冲洗和打印设备。§
20547§magnetic§mægˈnetɪk§The electric and magnetic fields are formed due to a passing wave oscillating at a regular frequency.§电场和**磁**场是由振波以固定频率振荡而形成的。§
20548§slippery§ˈslɪpəri§How damp and slippery the ground is!§地面又湿又**滑**！§
20549§graphic§ˈgræfɪk§The graphic record shows three waves are arriving.§**图表**记录显示有三股浪潮正在靠近。§
20550§provided§prəˈvaɪdɪd§I'll buy the cup, provided that the price is right.§**倘若**价格合适，我就买这个杯子。§
20551§examine§ɪgˈzæmɪn§He examined the work of other researchers.§他**检查**了其他研究人员的工作。§
20552§opportunity§ˌɒpəˈtjuːnəti§The film gave them an opportunity to let their imaginations run wild.§电影给了他们一个放任想象力纵情驰骋的**机会**。§
20553§distinguish§dɪˈstɪŋgwɪʃ§A port must be distinguished from a harbour. Harbour is a physical concept, and port is an economic concept.§必须**分清**港口和海港的区别，海港是一个物理概念，港口是一个经济概念。§
20554§blanket§ˈblæŋkɪt§It is so strange that this hotel does not provide sheets, blankets, or towels.§这家旅馆不提供被单、**毯子**和毛巾，真是奇怪。§
20555§arrogance§ˈærəgəns§His arrogance impressed us most unfavourably.§他的**傲慢**态度给我们留下了极坏的印象。§
20556§era§ˈɪərə§Dallas is a very wealthy city in Texas which has grown up in an era when cars were considered essential to move about.§达拉斯是得克萨斯州一个非常富裕的城市，兴起于汽车成为基本交通工具的**时代**。§
20557§stimulus§ˈstɪmjələs§The bright light is a stimulus to the eyes.§强光会**刺激**眼睛。§
20558§roam§rəʊm§If we go back ten thousand years ago we would find that there were lions roaming vast sections of the globe.§如果我们回到一万年前，就会发现地球上的大部分地方都有狮子**出没**。§
20559§comparison§kəmˈpærɪsn§We generally think of Africa as being a very hot and dry place, but it is not in comparison with Australia.§通常我们认为非洲炎热干燥，但它与澳大利亚没法**比**。§
20560§publicity§pʌbˈlɪsəti§The company launched a publicity campaign on a large scale.§这家公司发起了一场大规模的**宣传**活动。§
20561§depend§dɪˈpend§A: How much do the trips cost? B: Between five and fifteen pounds a head, depending on distance.§A: 旅行费是多少？B: 每个人5到15磅不等，**取决于**距离。§
20562§composition§ˌkɒmpəˈzɪʃn§There are many grammar errors in your composition.§你的**作文**中有很多语法错误。§
20563§architecture§ˈɑːkɪtektʃə(r)§The trend in architecture now favours smaller-scale building design.§现在**建筑设计**的流行趋势是小户型。§
20564§hurdle§ˈhɜːdl§It's still so hard for women to even get on to short lists—there are so many hurdles and barriers.§对于女性来说，想要进入最后的候选名单仍然很难，可谓是**障碍**重重。§
20565§teamwork§ˈtiːmwɜːk§An important part of teamwork is having trust in your colleagues' ability.§**团队协作**重要的一点就是要相信同事的能力。§
20566§damp§dæmp§The ground is very damp in the rainforest.§热带雨林的地面非常**潮湿**。§
20567§staff§stɑːf§Managers estimate staff productivity in terms of their working hours.§经理通过**职员**的工作时间来评估他们的生产效率。§
20568§symbol§ˈsɪmbl§The sounds of boat whistles and the moving tides are symbols of a port city.§汽笛声和海浪声是港口城市的**象征**。§
20569§apt§æpt§Artists are apt at revealing the inner world of human beings.§艺术家们**善于**表现人类的内心世界。§

20570§homogeneous§ˌhɒməˈdʒiːniəs§Uniforms can project the image of a company and unite the workforce into a homogeneous unit.§工装能展示一个公司的形象，并使公司内部的员工凝聚为一个**统一的**整体。§改译文：「整体」对应 unit，补出 homogeneous 的「统一的」
20571§conserve§kənˈsɜːv§People living in the desert have a special way to conserve water.§生活在沙漠里的人有一种特别的**储**水方法。§
20572§spasm§ˈspæzəm§The patient shudders with a sudden spasm.§病人突然**抽搐**，全身发抖。§
20573§invisible§ɪnˈvɪzəbl§Could there be another planet there, essentially similar to our own, but always invisible?§那里会不会有另一颗星球和我们的星球很相似，但我们却一直**看不见**呢？§
20574§devote§dɪˈvəʊt§The local newspapers were mainly devoted to regional news and gossip.§当地报纸主要**报道**地方新闻和小道消息。§
20575§illustrate§ˈɪləstreɪt§The diagram illustrates the information provided in paragraphs B-F of the reading.§该图**说明**了阅读材料中B~F段出现的信息。§
20576§terrace§ˈterəs§A terrace of five homes is under way beside my house.§我的房子旁边正在建造一幢能够居住五户的**连排房**。§
20577§dynamic§daɪˈnæmɪk§The market is so dynamic that the figures change almost every two weeks.§这个市场很**活跃**，数据几乎每两周就会发生改变。§
20578§throughout§θruːˈaʊt§There will be bus services to the university throughout the weekend.§**整个**周末都有公交车去这所大学。§
20579§smart§smɑːt§Most computer criminals are smart enough to cover their crimes.§大多数计算机犯罪分子都很**聪明**，能掩盖自己的罪行。§
20580§criticise§ˈkrɪtɪsaɪz§Citizens have the right to criticise the government.§公民有权利**批评**政府。§
20581§hunch§hʌntʃ§Younger school-aged children read stories on smartphones; older kids don't read at all, but hunch over video games.§较小的学龄儿童通过智能手机阅读故事；大一点的孩子根本不读书，而是喜欢**弓着背**玩电子游戏。§
20582§hinterland§ˈhɪntəlænd§A port is a centre of land-sea exchange which requires good access to a hinterland.§港口是海陆交易的中心，它需要与**内陆**有着便利的通道。§
